info.description: Complete modelwrap .info reference: ROOTHASH_OFFSET_VERITYUUID. OFFSET is a byte offset, a positive multiple of 4096 no greater than 4611686018427387904.

$comment: The agent also validates the numeric offset bounds and alignment and rejects non-normalized, duplicate, and overlapping mount paths. Input paths are resolved from policy-authorized OCI mounts, not supplied in initdata.
